core_acquisition.note: Only the target commit is a shallow boundary. Existing branch tips are unchanged; target ancestry is not available for merge-base decisions.

cape_comparison.gpio98_difference: Cape has pll_clk in the third alternate-function slot; target Waipio has NA. Cape pll_clk_groups also includes gpio98.
review_constraints: Retain Cape PHY calibration and register offsets; do not alias the Cape binding to Waipio data.
Keep target PHY common header/core together; validate supply handling and Cape host submode stays within NON_G4/G4.
Target G5 submode value 2 would be treated as G4 by the existing boolean Cape driver; no G5 enablement.
Cape non-VM pinctrl needs a wrapper without the absent VM GPIO trace-hook dependency; do not advertise unimplemented VM behavior.
Target pinctrl dereferences dir_conn for extra platform IRQs. Cape base DT has one IRQ, but the final composed target DT must retain that contract.
